title: The burger puzzle
caption: Burger math 🍔 Most people get this WRONG. Comment your answer 👇 #brainteaser #mathpuzzle #puzzle #iqtest #fyp

scenes.say: Ninety percent of people fail this burger puzzle.
Three burgers make forty five. A burger and two fries make twenty three. Fries and two colas make ten. So, cola plus burger times fries?
It's sixty three! Burger is fifteen, fries are four, cola is three. Fifteen times four is sixty, plus three is sixty three.
Drop your answer in the comments and follow for tomorrow's puzzle.
